coverage.claim_to_source_support: not automated in v0.3; requires reliable source full text
coverage.institutional_rules: default public profile; custom NovaPoint rules are a later private layer

findings.title: In-text citation missing from bibliography
findings.message: Doe (2021) appears in the text but no matching bibliography entry was found.
findings.suggestion: Add the source to the bibliography or correct the in-text citation.

findings.title: Table is not mentioned in the text
findings.message: Table 1 has a caption but no cross-reference elsewhere in the manuscript.
findings.suggestion: Discuss Table 1 in the body text.

findings.title: Bibliography entry is not cited
findings.message: Smith (2020) is listed in the bibliography but was not found in the body text.
evidence: Smith, J. (2020). Staff retention in hospitals. Journal of Health Research, 2(1), 1–10.
findings.suggestion: Cite the source in the text or remove it from the bibliography.

findings.title: Conflicting sample-size candidates
findings.message: The manuscript appears to report 2 different sample sizes.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether these values describe recruited, eligible, analysed, or subgroup samples and label them explicitly.

findings.title: Conflicting percentage candidates
findings.message: Different values are reported for response rate: 80%, 75%.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether the percentages use different populations or time points and label the denominator for each.

findings.title: Missing ethics or consent statement
findings.message: No ethics or consent statement was detected under the thesis profile.
findings.suggestion: Add an ethics or consent statement, or disable this rule in an institutional profile when it does not apply.

findings.title: Objective may not be addressed in findings
findings.message: No finding or conclusion item has strong keyword overlap with this objective.
evidence: Assess staff retention among nurses in Lagos hospitals.
Closest finding: The analysed sample included 140 participants. The response rate was 80% during data collection. The final response rate was 75%.
findings.suggestion: Confirm that the findings explicitly answer this objective.

findings.title: Missing AI-use disclosure
findings.message: No AI-use disclosure was detected under the thesis profile.
findings.suggestion: Add an AI-use disclosure, or disable this rule in an institutional profile when it does not apply.
